label: LEVEL 1
head: Body spray over yesterday's shirt
sub: Covering a smell isn't the same as not having one.

label: LEVEL 2
head: Deodorant every single morning
sub: Right after you dry off. Not at noon when you remember.

label: LEVEL 3
head: Scrub in the shower, not just water
sub: Then scented moisturizer. Dry skin can't hold a scent.

label: LEVEL 4
head: Fragrance on your pulse points
sub: Neck and wrists. 2 to 3 sprays. Not a cloud.

label: LEVEL 5
head: Fresh breath, every time
sub: Floss, brush your tongue, gum before you talk to her.

head: Smelling good is a *habit.* Not a spray.
